name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes from the code review: pausing right after Start now really stops the audio; exports include your whole history, not just the last 40 days (import brings preferences back too); reopening a session can no longer double-count BFR; snoozed reminders survive; a quick one only counts when you finish it; and the app rolls over at midnight if left open.

Reminders now work from the wrist: when a quick one or a round is due, the watch notification has a Start button that begins it with the phone locked. Snooze and "Done already" work from the watch too.

Quick ones now start from the watch with the phone locked: the phone keeps the next quick one rendered and ready, same as Barefoot PT and Hips.
A session that runs to the end while the phone sleeps is credited when you open the phone.
